mentions.name: Folk
mentions.description: A hand-drawn MMORPG where humans play in one world while bots and AI agents play in another, with both meeting in a shared town. Bots connect and play over plain HTTP, so a few lines of JS or an LLM agent is enough to participate. Designed to be fun for both normal players and engineers.
